slides.title: Install ATAK from Playstore or APK
slides.html:
• To start using ATAK, you need to install the app from Google Play.
  • Deploy App's TAK page offers you the link for it.
  • ATAK/CivTAK application is exactly the same app as so-called MilTAK - the difference is that MilTAK app accepts MilTAK-signed plugins.

slides.title: 1. Open ATAK and give permissions
slides.html: • Once installed, find the TAK icon from your phone and open the application.

slides.title: Permissions 1
slides.html:
• The EULA pops up.
  • Tap I agree.

slides.title: Permissions 2
slides.html:
• ATAK app asks a number of permissions within your phone.

  • The permission rationale explains, that none of user data ends up to the TAK developers (U.S. TPC).

  • What these permissions enable is to make your TAK data to flow to your unit's TAK Server, which is operated by eg. FDF.

  • No other data than what happens in ATAK is concerned here.

  • Tap I understand to continue.

slides.title: Permissions 3
slides.html:
• Allow ATAK to take pictures or video.
  • This is required for Quick Pic and video sharing features.
  • Choose While using the app.

slides.title: Permissions 4
slides.html:
• Allow ATAK to access location.
  • This is required for Blue force tracking to work, ie. to have your symbol appear to the map.
  • Choose Precise and While using app.

slides.title: Permissions 5
slides.html:
• Allow ATAK to record audio.
  • This is required for calls to teammates started from ATAK.
  • Choose While using the app.

slides.title: Permissions 6
slides.html:
• Allow ATAK to find nearby devices.
  • This is required for using ATAK in broadcast mode (communicate with other ATAKs in local network, WiFi or eg. radio connection).
  • Choose Allow.

slides.title: Permissions 7
slides.html:
• Allow ATAK to send notifications.
  • This is required for having notifications from ATAK.
  • Choose Allow.

slides.title: Permissions 8
slides.html:
• Allow ATAK make phone calls and manage calls.
  • This is required for calls to teammates started from ATAK.
  • Choose Allow.

slides.title: Permissions 9
slides.html:
• Allow ATAK to access music and audio files.
  • This is required for being able to send audio messages over the TAK Server.
  • Choose Allow.

slides.title: Permissions 10
slides.html:
• Allow ATAK to access photos and videos.
  • This is required for Quick Pic and video sharing features.
  • Choose Allow all.

slides.title: Permissions 11
slides.html:
• Allow ATAK to use location on background.
  • This is required for Blue force tracking to work, ie. to have your symbol appear to the map.
  • Choose I understand.

slides.title: Permissions 12
slides.html:
• Acknowledge the Android 11+ warning about location in background.
  • Choose OK.

slides.title: Permissions 13
slides.html:
• ATAK needs you to do change a location permission from Android settings in order to the Blue force tracking feature to work.
  • Read instructions and do the steps as follows. Tap I understand to continue.

slides.title: Permissions 14
slides.html:
• The Android setting for App info opens automatically.
  • Tap Permissions.

slides.title: Permissions 15
slides.html:
• Next, tap App permission.
  • Then tap Location to open location permission settings.

slides.title: Permissions 16
slides.html:
• In the Location permission menu, tap Allow all the time.
  • This enables ATAK to continuously send your location to the TAK Server which is required for the blue force tracking feature to work.
  • After doing this, return to ATAK.

slides.title: Permissions 17
slides.html:
• If you start up ATAK for the first time, the TAK Device Setup menu will appear.
  • We don't need anything from here, so close it by tapping Done.

slides.title: Permissions 18
slides.html:
• Finally, the app asks you to disable the Android battery optimization feature.
  • This is important, as Android may randomly block ATAK from sending and receiving location data because of this.
  • Press OK in order to the next dialog to open.

slides.title: Permissions 19
slides.html:
• Android asks you whether to stop optimizing battery usage.
  • Tap Allow.
  • This concludes setting permissions with your freshly-installed ATAK app.
